description:
* Grab your goblin friends, as Goblin Cleanup is coming to PlayStation 5 in 2027 🧹 *

Goblin Cleanup is a co-op cleaning game where you have to clean and rearrange a dungeon before the next adventurers come to complete it again! 🫧

*🫧 ABOUT GOBLIN CLEANUP*

Assume the role of a professional cleaner hired by the dungeon manager to clean and prepare the dungeon for the next adventure. You can perform this task alone or with up to three companions, cooperatively or maybe not so cooperatively!

*Key Features*

*🧹 Clean:* It's your job to clean up the mess, so clean it up you shall! Use your Slimop, mimic, and slime dispenser tool to help you remove all that blood from the floor and ceiling!

*🪑 Restore Objects:* To ensure the dungeon returns to its original state, you must restore objects and place them back in their original positions.

author: PlayStation
description:
Throw, fight, and squabble your way to victory in Prinny Party: Going Overboard! when it launches for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Steam later this year.

Where there's a Prinny, there's a party! Get together with your friends to do whatever it takes to defeat the Supreme Overboard and his Protago-Knights—including stabbing each other in the back!

In this party game, you'll move around the board, earn experience, acquire more powerful equipment, and turn in quests to stay ahead of the curve. Then, when a boss spawns, you'll work together to take him down. But friendships don't last long in Prinny Party—only the player who brings the boss back to spawn gets the credit!

#ps5 #ps5games
title: Prinny Party: Going Overboard! - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
